_comment: Barn-find restoration, done at the home carport's Restore bench. Each stage costs money and workshop hours, scaled per car by cost_scale. A car can be driven once every stage marked 'needed_to_drive' is done; the rest are looks. The last choice picks original spec or a restomod.

stages.title: Strip and assess
stages.text: Drag it out, drain the old fuel, find out how bad it is.

stages.title: Engine rebuild
stages.text: New rings, bearings and seals. The twin coughs into life.

stages.title: Brakes and suspension
stages.text: Seized drums freed, new kingpins, fresh fluid.

stages.title: Rust and panels
stages.text: Cut out the rust, let in new floor pans and sills.

stages.title: Paint
stages.text: Back to bare metal and a fresh coat in its original colour.

stages.title: Interior
stages.text: Re-covered seats, a new headliner, the roof canvas restitched.

stages.title: Chrome and trim
stages.text: Re-chromed bumpers, new badges, rubber seals all round.

restomod.title: Restomod
restomod.text: Bigger bore, twin-choke carb, front discs and sticky tyres.
